proposal_status.title: Proposal Status
proposal_status.description: ProposalStatus enumerates the valid statuses of a proposal.

voter.description: voter defines the voter address for the proposals.

depositor.description: depositor defines the deposit addresses from the proposals.

pagination.description: pagination defines an optional pagination for the request.

cosmos.gov.v1.QueryProposalsRequest.title: Query Proposals Request
cosmos.gov.v1.QueryProposalsRequest.description: QueryProposalsRequest is the request type for the Query/Proposals RPC method.

key.description: key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key should be set.

offset.description: offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable. It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should be set.

limit.description: limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page. If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

count_total.description: count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs. count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key is set.

reverse.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title: Page Request
cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.description: PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient pagination. Ex:  message SomeRequest {          Foo some_parameter = 1;          PageRequest pagination = 2;  }

proposals.description: proposals defines all the requested governance proposals.

pagination.description: pagination defines the pagination in the response.

cosmos.gov.v1.QueryProposalsResponse.title: Query Proposals Response
cosmos.gov.v1.QueryProposalsResponse.description: QueryProposalsResponse is the response type for the Query/Proposals RPC method.

next_key.description: next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if there are no more results.

total.description: total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total was set, its value is undefined otherwise

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageResponse.title: Page Response
cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageResponse.description: PageResponse is to be embedded in gRPC response messages where the corresponding request message has used PageRequest.  message SomeResponse {          repeated Bar results = 1;          PageResponse page = 2;  }

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.title: Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description: Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.

id.description: id defines the unique id of the proposal.

type_url.description: The type url prefixed with a slash, like '/cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgSend'

value.description: Must be a valid serialized protocol buffer of the above specified type.

items.title: Any
items.description: Contains the serialized protocol buffer message using the response bytes from `/dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryEncodeJsonRequest`

messages.description: messages are the arbitrary messages to be executed if the proposal passes.

status.title: Proposal Status
status.description: ProposalStatus enumerates the valid statuses of a proposal.

final_tally_result.description: final_tally_result is the final tally result of the proposal. When querying a proposal via gRPC, this field is not populated until the proposal's voting period has ended.

submit_time.description: submit_time is the time of proposal submission.

deposit_end_time.description: deposit_end_time is the end time for deposition.

total_deposit.description: total_deposit is the total deposit on the proposal.

voting_start_time.description: voting_start_time is the starting time to vote on a proposal.

voting_end_time.description: voting_end_time is the end time of voting on a proposal.

metadata.description: metadata is any arbitrary metadata attached to the proposal. the recommended format of the metadata is to be found here: https://docs.cosmos.network/v0.47/modules/gov#proposal-3

title.description: title is the title of the proposal

summary.description: summary is a short summary of the proposal

proposer.description: proposer is the address of the proposal sumbitter

expedited.description: expedited defines if the proposal is expedited

failed_reason.description: failed_reason defines the reason why the proposal failed

cosmos.gov.v1.Proposal.title: Proposal
cosmos.gov.v1.Proposal.description: Proposal defines the core field members of a governance proposal.

yes_count.description: yes_count is the number of yes votes on a proposal.

abstain_count.description: abstain_count is the number of abstain votes on a proposal.

no_count.description: no_count is the number of no votes on a proposal.

no_with_veto_count.description: no_with_veto_count is the number of no with veto votes on a proposal.

cosmos.gov.v1.TallyResult.title: Tally Result
cosmos.gov.v1.TallyResult.description: TallyResult defines a standard tally for a governance proposal.
